j1.what_the_patch_does: Installs coverage in CI, reruns the test suite under coverage, and fails the workflow if coverage is below 70%.
j1.reading_applied: Applied the rule directly: a coverage gate is any CI threshold that fails based on coverage; this patch adds one as part of the standard workflow.
j1.rationale: The rule explicitly ruled out adding coverage gates. `coverage report --fail-under=70` is a coverage gate, and it is mandatory in the CI job rather than merely an optional path. Both the narrow and broad readings therefore find a violation.

j2.what_the_patch_does: Installs coverage, reruns the tests under coverage, and fails CI when reported coverage is below 70%.
j2.reading_applied: Literal reading: the rule rules out adding coverage gates, including a CI fail-under threshold.
j2.rationale: The new 'Enforce test coverage' step uses `coverage report --fail-under=70`, which is a coverage gate: it makes CI fail based on coverage percentage.
